delivery.manifest_scope: Original delivered bytes, not the subsequently reviewed files. Parent WDP release inventories bind the reviewed tree.

wdp_attachment.reason: The original manuscript attachment bytes were not supplied with the delivered package.

mathematical_review.accepted_scope: Finite rational presentations over their real extensions, a shared raw-realization/repair image, unrestricted rational scalar measurements, and faithful rational polyhedral norms.
preserved_distinctions: Every section defect Ds is exact and has quotient mass zero.
The LGGR and Projection Obstruction coupled report conventions differ.
The scalar zero-observer example is a new extension, not a source observer.
Minimum row count and minimum recovery constant are different objectives.
corrections: Zero recovery domain gives constant zero; zero report space with nonzero recovery domain gives infinity.
Rational query vectors are required for rational distance certificates.
Zero-dimensional norms and distance certificates use an explicit vacuous branch.
mathematical_review.novelty_scope: Integrated source-bound derivation using standard linear algebra, quotient norms, polyhedral enumeration and LP certificates. No priority or global novelty claim.

checker_repairs: Strict JSON admission rejects duplicate keys, floats and nonfinite constants.
Wire matrices require exact dimensions and canonical rational strings; booleans are not scalars or integer dimensions.
Receipt claims bind to separately supplied expected inputs, targets and norms.
Adapted inverse matrices must also have the declared subspace order.
Active vertex indices, independence, equations and complete enumeration are checked.
Initial failure and weighted-distance query claims are checked and bound.
Unknown fields and nested authority claims are refused.
Vacuity flags retain Boolean type and zero-dimensional distance conventions are explicit.

execution.runtime: Bundled Python with standard-library Fraction arithmetic; pytest loaded from existing local dependencies.
execution.pytest_command: PYTHONPATH=code plus installed pytest; PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1; python -B -m pytest code/unit_tests/test_observer_completion.py -o addopts= -q --tb=short --basetemp <fresh external temporary directory>
execution.independent_rank_oracle: Nonzero determinant minors, without the implementation's row elimination; 81 small D/Q presentations and 243 completions.
execution.regeneration: Source and generic receipts regenerated and compared with unchanged delivered JSON in the scoped tests.
